mostWorthwhile.text: Separating the chromosome sets and then dividing the cell made two distinct parts of cell division clear. The tightening ring also connected back to the muscle machinery described earlier.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the prepared renewal examples to the body was straightforward but repetitive; the biological processes had already been shown.

surprise.text: The low-oxygen cue clarified why a kidney signal would affect red-cell production in marrow.

arbitrary.text: The final three fittings had clear purposes because their slots matched the renewal examples. None felt especially arbitrary.

continue.text: I would continue if another chapter offered a new interaction or question. The links between cell-level processes and the functioning body were interesting, though the final fittings were predictable.
